mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a pleasant 79 degrees at Fireman's Park with clear skies. The First Quarter moon is out, and tonight at 9:33 PM, you can catch the International Space Station passing by. It will rise in the northwest over Middleton near the high school and travel toward Fitchburg in the east, reaching about halfway up the sky.

Stay informed on city business through the VHAT cable channel 989, which provides access to government meetings and community programs. Also, remember that city code requires vehicles to be parked on approved surfaces, so ensure your recreational equipment is properly stored away from property lines.

There is plenty to do this week in Verona. Tuesday features trivia at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company, while Wednesday brings the Farmer's Market downtown and pizza at Lake Louie. Thursday rounds out the fun with Concerts in the Park at Century School Park.

In a report covering July 13 through July 20, a noteworthy incident occurred on July 14, when a driver was stopped for driving without headlights and officers discovered marijuana, drug paraphernalia, and a firearm in the vehicle.
Culver's is serving up the Chocolate Caramel Twist today. They are open until 10 PM, giving you plenty of time to stop by for a scoop before the end of the night.
